class.name: TextureStreamingSettingsServer
class.brief_description: Settings server for texture streaming: on or off, VRAM budget and mip levels.

method.name: get_max_lod
method.description: Returns the pending worst mip level. See [member TextureStreamingSettings.max_lod].

method.name: get_memory_budget_bytes_used
method.description: Returns the VRAM used by streamed textures now, in bytes ([method TextureStreaming.get_memory_budget_bytes_used]), for example to show it next to [method get_memory_budget_mb] in a settings menu. Returns [code]0[/code] if texture streaming does not run.

method.name: get_memory_budget_mb
method.description: Returns the pending memory budget in MiB. See [member TextureStreamingSettings.memory_budget_mb].

method.name: get_min_lod
method.description: Returns the pending best mip level. See [member TextureStreamingSettings.min_lod].

method.name: get_unsupported_setting_names
method.description: Returns the names of the values the current renderer ignores: all of them in the Compatibility renderer, none in Forward+ and Mobile. See [method SettingsServer.is_value_supported].

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns the pending texture streaming (at the next start). See [member TextureStreamingSettings.enabled].

method.name: is_memory_budget_enabled
method.description: Returns the pending memory budget. See [member TextureStreamingSettings.memory_budget_enabled].

method.name: is_renderer_supported
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the current renderer can stream textures (Forward+ and Mobile, not Compatibility).

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Sets the texture streaming (at the next start) (setting [code]"enabled"[/code]). See [member TextureStreamingSettings.enabled].

method.name: set_max_lod
method.description: Sets the worst mip level (setting [code]"max_lod"[/code]). See [member TextureStreamingSettings.max_lod].

method.name: set_memory_budget_mb
method.description: Sets the memory budget in MiB (setting [code]"memory_budget_mb"[/code]). See [member TextureStreamingSettings.memory_budget_mb].

method.name: set_min_lod
method.description: Sets the best mip level (setting [code]"min_lod"[/code]). See [member TextureStreamingSettings.min_lod].
